frozen_contract.reps: blocks (n=5 per arm x length x platform)
frozen_contract.ci: paired-block 95pct percentile bootstrap, B=10000, seed base 20260921 + crc32 per-contrast offsets
frozen_contract.gating_orin: matrix_pass + arrival_ok + completion==64; None dropped per block, never pooled
frozen_contract.gating_a5000: pass + completion==64 + prompt==L + bg_alive_offset==bg + bg_alive_firsttok_cb==bg; block value = mean of 2 bg cells (bg1+bg4)
frozen_contract.bg_asymmetry: A5000 blocks average bg1+bg4 cells; Orin matrix cells are bg4 only. bg_gap_max cross compares block means across this asymmetry; kept descriptive.
frozen_contract.joules_rule: NO cross-platform joules RoR: Orin rails (VDD_GPU_SOC+VDD_CPU_CV+VIN_SYS_5V0) vs A5000 GPU1 power.draw are incommensurate sensors; within-platform joules ratios only.
frozen_contract.pooling_rule: boards never pooled; RoR resamples independently
frozen_contract.retain_asymmetry: Orin retain = device-hit resume (cached 2052/4104/6010 toks, TTFT 0.12/0.15s) while A5000 retain = post-eviction cold resume (cached dev 1 tok, TTFT == recompute). Ratios over retain therefore have different denominators by design; absolute diffs are the honest cross-board comparison and every RoR inherits the version confound.
frozen_contract.file_tier_descriptive: Orin file-overflow quiet reload 17.0s vs nvme-direct device-hit 0.12-0.15s (~130x, Strand A vs B descriptive, no pooled statistic crosses strands).

import.a5000_seal: PASS sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS: 168/168 OK, 0 fail (169 files on disk = 168 sealed + SHA256SUMS)
import.a5000_gating: 80/80 cells PASS (4 arms x 5 blocks x 2L x 2bg)
import.orin_ref: results/summary.json rev2: matrix-v1 60/60 meas cells PASS (L2048/L6011/L4096); cross uses L2048+L6011 common with A5000
